03-03-2026

🚨 Traffic Advisory | Karuma Bridge, along Kampala–Gulu Highway.

The Uganda Police team operating along the Karuma Bridge area has informed us of a planned exercise tomorrow to retrieve an overturned trailer at Karuma Bridge between 9:00am to 12:00pm.

#DURATION: The exercise is expected to last approximately 03 hours or less. 

#DELAYS: Traffic delays and temporary inconvenience expected during this period.

#ADVISORY: Motorists are advised to;
• Plan their journey accordingly
• Allow for extra travel time
• Strictly follow Traffic Police guidance on site
• Approach the area with caution

We appreciate your patience as the teams work to restore full and safe traffic flow.
